Call of Duty Black ops 3 has brought along a completely new Weapon System. The new Weapon System contains a lot of nicer and feature rich functions. We have documented as much as we currently know about the functions and functionality of said functions. The following links will guide you through working with the new Weapon System.

- BO3 | Weapon entity field list (Weapon-entity-field-list)

-  BO3 | Weapon Giving from Script (Weapon-Giving-from-Script)

- BO3 | Weapon List (Weapon-List)
